p:cNvPr.name: スライド イメージ プレースホルダー 1
ノート プレースホルダー 2

a:r.a:t: Remind people that some fish and seafood can be contaminated with mercury and raise awareness of the essential need for uncontaminated local sources.
Advise people to limit their intake of POPs from food by following the advice of the local food-safety authorities.

Identify traditional practices and folk medicines as sources of mercury and spread awareness of the potential harm from their use. Work with individuals and communities to identify substitute practices.
Advise people about the dangers of informal recycling of lead-containing products in and around the home backyard and community areas.

Advise people against keeping toxic chemicals in the home. Promote the safe packaging and clear labelling of toxic substances, as well as their storage out of the reach of children to prevent poisoning.
Identify and report to the local authorities the potential point sources of environmental exposure in communities, such as hazardous
waste sites, artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM), or electronic waste-recycling activities
Advise parents and caretakers about the importance of preventing children from accessing waste sites, especially hazardous waste sites.
